rounding: Display only; retain float for calculations
order: Mean final Elo over 32 saved random whole-tournament orders; each run resets original initial ratings

shuffle_ensemble.reset: Original initial ratings independently for every run
shuffle_ensemble.randomization: All 540 games freely shuffled, no fixed Kata positions
shuffle_ensemble.aggregation: Arithmetic mean of the 32 final ratings, floating point retained
shuffle_ensemble.recent_delta: Mean of the game rating changes across the same 32 runs

color_adjustment.method: One common black offset; bisection matches mean predicted black total to observed black points over the same 32 sequential Elo orders, including strength differences and rating feedback
color_adjustment.interpretation: Empirical adjustment for this tournament; not a universal or causal Ataxx color advantage
